title: Dockerfile 反模式检查器（正反两组用例）
expected_output:

  RUN          apt-get install -y curl vim

  WORKDIR      /app
  RUN          pip install -r requirements.txt
  EXPOSE       8080
  CMD          ["python", "app.py"]

  [命中] RUN-AS-ROOT        未设置非 root 的 USER：容器逃逸时直接拿到 root
  [命中] NO-DOCKERIGNORE    缺少 .dockerignore：.git / node_modules / 日志被塞进构建上下文
  [命中] ADD-ABUSE          对本地普通文件用 ADD（./config.ini /app/config.ini）：语义比 COPY 宽，容易误解压，应改 COPY

code:
# Dockerfile 静态反模式检查器：六条可判定的规则，正反两组 Dockerfile 对照。

BAD_DF = r"""FROM ubuntu:latest
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y curl vim
ADD ./config.ini /app/config.ini
COPY . /app
WORKDIR /app
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
"""

GOOD_DF = r"""FROM python:3.13.1-slim
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && useradd -u 10001 app
COPY src/ ./src/
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz')"
CMD ["python", "src/app.py"]
"""


def parse(text):
    logical, buf = [], ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.rstrip()
        if buf:
            buf = buf.rstrip("\\") + " " + line.strip()
            if not line.endswith("\\"):
                logical.append(buf)
                buf = ""
            continue
        if line.endswith("\\"):
            buf = line
        else:
            logical.append(line)
    out = []
    for s in (x.strip() for x in logical):
        if not s or s.startswith("#"):
            continue
        p = s.split(None, 1)
        out.append((p[0].upper(), p[1] if len(p) > 1 else ""))
    return out


def check(instrs, has_dockerignore=True):
    """返回 [(规则名, 是否命中, 说明)]，命中即违规。"""
    runs = [a for ins, a in instrs if ins == "RUN"]
    froms = [a for ins, a in instrs if ins == "FROM"]
    copies = [(ins, a) for ins, a in instrs if ins in ("COPY", "ADD")]
    findings = []

    # 1) apt-get update 与 install 必须在同一条 RUN（否则索引被缓存，装到过期包）
    has_update = any("apt-get update" in r for r in runs)
    same_run = any("apt-get update" in r and "apt-get install" in r for r in runs)
    findings.append(("APT-UPDATE-SPLIT", has_update and not same_run,
                     "apt-get update 与 install 分在两条 RUN：索引层被缓存，会装到过期/已撤销的包"))

    # 2) 基础镜像不得用 latest（不可复现）
    latest = any(f.split(":")[-1] == "latest" or ":" not in f for f in froms)
    findings.append(("LATEST-TAG", latest,
                     "基础镜像使用 latest 或省略标签：构建不可复现，上游一改你的产物就变了"))

    # 3) 必须显式 USER（默认 root）
    users = [a for ins, a in instrs if ins == "USER"]
    run_as_root = not users or users[-1].split(":")[0] in ("0", "root")
    findings.append(("RUN-AS-ROOT", run_as_root,
                     "未设置非 root 的 USER：容器逃逸时直接拿到 root"))

    # 4) 必须有 .dockerignore（否则上下文污染 + COPY . 缓存频繁失效）
    findings.append(("NO-DOCKERIGNORE", not has_dockerignore,
                     "缺少 .dockerignore：.git / node_modules / 日志被塞进构建上下文"))

    # 5) ADD 只应在「确实需要自动解压本地归档」时使用
    add_abuse = [a for ins, a in copies
                 if ins == "ADD" and not a.split()[0].lower().endswith(
                     (".tar", ".tar.gz", ".tgz", ".tar.bz2", ".tar.xz"))]
    findings.append(("ADD-ABUSE", bool(add_abuse),
                     "对本地普通文件用 ADD（%s）：语义比 COPY 宽，容易误解压，应改 COPY"
                     % (add_abuse[0] if add_abuse else "")))

    # 6) 安装依赖后要清理缓存
    dirty = [r for r in runs
             if ("apt-get install" in r and "rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists" not in r)
             or ("pip install" in r and "--no-cache-dir" not in r)
             or ("npm install" in r and "npm cache clean" not in r)]
    findings.append(("CACHE-NOT-CLEANED", bool(dirty),
                     "安装依赖后未清理包管理器缓存：镜像凭空增大几十到几百 MB"))

    return findings


def report(name, instrs, has_dockerignore):
    print("=== %s ===" % name)
    for ins, arg in instrs:
        print("  %-12s %s" % (ins, arg.replace("\n", " ")[:60]))
    print("  .dockerignore 存在: %s" % has_dockerignore)
    print("  --- 检查结果 ---")
    findings = check(instrs, has_dockerignore)
    hit = 0
    for rid, bad, desc in findings:
        if bad:
            hit += 1
            print("  [命中] %-18s %s" % (rid, desc))
        else:
            print("  [通过] %-18s %s" % (rid, "无此问题"))
    print("  命中 %d / %d 条规则 -> 检查通过: %s" % (hit, len(findings), hit == 0))
    print()
    return hit


b = report("[反例] 典型新手 Dockerfile", parse(BAD_DF), has_dockerignore=False)
g = report("[正例] 修正后的 Dockerfile", parse(GOOD_DF), has_dockerignore=True)

print("=== 汇总 ===")
print("规则总数 = 6，反例命中 = %d，正例命中 = %d" % (b, g))
print("反例不通过 / 正例通过: %s / %s" % (b > 0, g == 0))
print("其中 APT-UPDATE-SPLIT 与 CACHE-NOT-CLEANED 是线上最常见的两条: True")
